CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assistant_active_run ON assistant_runs(conversation_id)
        WHERE state IN ('queued','preparing','routing','retrieving','generating','persisting')
CREATE INDEX assistant_owner ON assistant_conversations(owner_id, id)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assistant_user_input ON assistant_messages(conversation_id, source_revision)
        WHERE role='user'
CREATE INDEX intake_owner ON intake_cases(owner_id, id)

CREATE TABLE approvals (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	approver_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (matter_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(approver_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE assistant_attachment_parses (
        conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, attachment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
        request_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
        parser_version TEXT NOT NULL, baseline_view TEXT,
        reading_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(reading_status IN ('readable','partial','needs_baseline','failed')),
        result_json TEXT, result_sha256 TEXT, failure_code TEXT,
        actor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(attachment_id, revision),
        FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id, attachment_id) REFERENCES assistant_attachments(conversation_id, id),
        UNIQUE(conversation_id, request_id))

CREATE TABLE assistant_attachments (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
        conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assistant_conversations(id),
        workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
        request_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
        original_name TEXT NOT NULL, mime TEXT NOT NULL,
        byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_size > 0),
        sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, storage_ref TEXT NOT NULL, policy_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        actor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(conversation_id, request_id), UNIQUE(conversation_id, id))

CREATE TABLE assistant_conversations (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
        request_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
        scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('conversation','intake','matter')),
        scope_ref TEXT,
        binding_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(binding_revision > 0),
        input_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(input_revision >= 0),
        materials_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(materials_revision >= 0),
        composer_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(composer_revision >= 0),
        projection_intake_id TEXT REFERENCES intake_cases(id),
        display_title TEXT NOT NULL, draft_input TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, archived_at TEXT,
        CHECK((scope_kind='conversation' AND scope_ref IS NULL) OR
              (scope_kind!='conversation' AND scope_ref IS NOT NULL)),
        UNIQUE(owner_id, request_id))

CREATE TABLE assistant_material_snapshots (
        conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assistant_conversations(id),
        revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
        kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('upload','parse','selection')),
        request_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, items_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        actor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(conversation_id, revision), UNIQUE(conversation_id, request_id))

CREATE TABLE assistant_messages (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
        conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assistant_conversations(id),
        role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('user','assistant')),
        content TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(source_revision > 0))

CREATE TABLE assistant_model_attempts (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
        run_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES assistant_runs(id),
        conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assistant_conversations(id),
        policy_id TEXT NOT NULL, config_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, policy_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
        request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, input_json TEXT NOT NULL, config_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        policy_json TEXT NOT NULL, reserved_usd TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('reserved','sending','sent_unknown','received','failed_before_send')),
        claim_sha256 TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE assistant_model_outputs (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
        attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES assistant_model_attempts(id),
        conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assistant_conversations(id),
        run_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES assistant_runs(id),
        scope_json TEXT NOT NULL, output_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE assistant_model_receipts (
        attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES assistant_model_attempts(id),
        receipt_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE assistant_run_events (
        run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assistant_runs(id),
        seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(seq > 0), event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        audience TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(audience IN ('internal','client')),
        payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(run_id, seq))

CREATE TABLE assistant_runs (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
        conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assistant_conversations(id),
        message_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES assistant_messages(id),
        actor_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
        session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id),
        request_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
        scope_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
        state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','preparing','routing','retrieving',
            'generating','persisting','completed','cancelled','failed','interrupted','awaiting_input','blocked')),
        requested_skill TEXT CHECK(requested_skill IN ('client_reply','material_organize',
            'contract_review','content_draft','legal_research')),
        selected_provider TEXT, selected_model TEXT, budget_json TEXT,
        cancel_requested INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(cancel_requested IN (0,1)),
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE(conversation_id, request_id))

CREATE TABLE audit_events (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE authority_snapshots (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	supersedes_id VARCHAR(36), 
	classification VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(supersedes_id) REFERENCES authority_snapshots (id)
)

CREATE TABLE authority_verifications (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	authority_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	attestation_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	reviewer_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	evidence TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(authority_id) REFERENCES authority_snapshots (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attestation_id) REFERENCES source_attestations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewer_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE document_versions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	uploaded_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	supersedes_id VARCHAR(36), 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (matter_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id, supersedes_id) REFERENCES document_versions (matter_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(uploaded_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE export_records (
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ref VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	parent VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sequence), 
	UNIQUE (ref), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id)
)

CREATE TABLE exports (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	approval_id VARCHAR(36), 
	superseded BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id, approval_id) REFERENCES approvals (matter_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id)
)

CREATE TABLE fact_decisions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	source_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	target_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	fact_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id, source_version) REFERENCES fact_snapshots (matter_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id, target_version) REFERENCES fact_snapshots (matter_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE fact_snapshots (
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (matter_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id)
)

CREATE TABLE intake_cases (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
        request_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
        current_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, matter_id TEXT REFERENCES matters(id),
        conversion_sha256 TEXT, UNIQUE(owner_id, request_id))

CREATE TABLE intake_revisions (
        intake_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES intake_cases(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
        saved_at TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL,
        client_reply TEXT NOT NULL, internal_notes TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(intake_id, revision))
CREATE TABLE local_workspace_identity (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE matter_memberships (
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	can_sign BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (matter_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE matters (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	file_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	total_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE ocr_candidates (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	document_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_version_id) REFERENCES document_versions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE ops_file_relocations (
	logical_ref TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	physical_ref TEXT NOT NULL, 
	archive_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	record_refs TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (logical_ref, sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE ops_restore_fences (
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ref VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	archive_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	manifest_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sequence), 
	UNIQUE (ref)
)

CREATE TABLE page_verifications (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE parse_snapshots (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	document_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_version_id) REFERENCES document_versions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE party_decisions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	party_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	target_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	before_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	after_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id, party_id, source_revision) REFERENCES party_snapshots (matter_id, party_id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id, party_id, target_revision) REFERENCES party_snapshots (matter_id, party_id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE party_snapshots (
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	party_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	record_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (matter_id, party_id, revision), 
	UNIQUE (record_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE policy_approvals (
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reviewer_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	evidence TEXT NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id, version) REFERENCES policy_snapshots (matter_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewer_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE policy_snapshots (
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	client_ref TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (matter_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id)
)

CREATE TABLE provider_records (
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ref VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	parent VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36), 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sequence), 
	UNIQUE (ref)
)

CREATE TABLE query_ledger (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	plan_ref VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	item_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	page INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	preimage TEXT NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	call_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	dispatch_token_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	send_claimed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_ref) REFERENCES query_plan_versions (ref), 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key)
)

CREATE TABLE query_plan_versions (
	ref VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (ref), 
	UNIQUE (plan_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id)
)

CREATE TABLE query_records (
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ref VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	parent VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sequence), 
	UNIQUE (ref), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id)
)

CREATE TABLE review_model_attempts (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	raw TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES review_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE review_operation_attempts (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	record_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	raw TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(record_id) REFERENCES review_operation_records (id)
)

CREATE TABLE review_operation_records (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	phase VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE review_proposals (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (run_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES review_runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE review_runs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	context_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	config_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	processed_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE rule_approvals (
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	rule_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reviewer_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	rule_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	dependency_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	evidence TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id, rule_id, version) REFERENCES rule_snapshots (matter_id, rule_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewer_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE rule_invalidations (
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	rule_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id, rule_id, version) REFERENCES rule_snapshots (matter_id, rule_id, version)
)

CREATE TABLE rule_manager_grants (
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	enabled VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE rule_snapshots (
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	rule_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	policy_binding_json TEXT, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (matter_id, rule_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id)
)

CREATE TABLE sessions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	csrf_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	revoked BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	UNIQUE (token_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE source_attestations (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	authority_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	reviewer_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	classification VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	provenance_ref TEXT NOT NULL, 
	evidence TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(authority_id) REFERENCES authority_snapshots (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewer_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE source_evidence (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	authority_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	acquired_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	source_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	original_bytes BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(authority_id) REFERENCES authority_snapshots (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(acquired_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	roles TEXT NOT NULL, 
	disabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (username)
)

CREATE TABLE web_finding_decisions (
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	finding_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	run_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sequence), 
	UNIQUE (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES review_runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE web_http_writes (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_scope VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	response_matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	request_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	response_matter_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (matter_scope, actor_id, action, idempotency_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(response_matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE web_job_events (
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(80), 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES web_jobs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE web_jobs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	matter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	input_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	matter_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	stage VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(80), 
	result_ref VARCHAR(100), 
	timestamp VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (matter_id, actor_id, kind, idempotency_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(matter_id) REFERENCES matters (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions (id)
)
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_assistant_attachment_parses_delete BEFORE DELETE ON assistant_attachment_parses BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'IMMUTABLE_RECORD'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_assistant_attachment_parses_update BEFORE UPDATE ON assistant_attachment_parses BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'IMMUTABLE_RECORD'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_assistant_attachments_delete BEFORE DELETE ON assistant_attachments BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'IMMUTABLE_RECORD'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_assistant_attachments_update BEFORE UPDATE ON assistant_attachments BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'IMMUTABLE_RECORD'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_assistant_conversations_delete BEFORE DELETE ON assistant_conversations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'IMMUTABLE_RECORD'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_assistant_material_snapshots_delete BEFORE DELETE ON assistant_material_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'IMMUTABLE_RECORD'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_assistant_material_snapshots_update BEFORE UPDATE ON assistant_material_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'IMMUTABLE_RECORD'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_assistant_messages_delete BEFORE DELETE ON assistant_messages BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'IMMUTABLE_RECORD'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_assistant_messages_update BEFORE UPDATE ON assistant_messages BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'IMMUTABLE_RECORD'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_assistant_model_attempts_delete BEFORE DELETE ON assistant_model_attempts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'IMMUTABLE_RECORD'); END
